description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Mouser Foundry.
When Mouser Foundry enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Robot and the Mouser Foundry token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Mouser Foundry triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Robot, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
